title: SelectionToolsConfig
description: Whether the selection tools are on for this page, and whether the toolbar shows.

enabled.description: False when the remote flag or the AI toggle is off, and on native's own sites: no selection is reported and contextMenuOpened is not sent. A page that loaded with the feature off doesn't run it, so turning it on reaches that page only once it reloads.

showToolbar.description: The user's setting for the toolbar, as in the feature's showToolbar setting. When false, no selection is reported, but contextMenuOpened is still sent while enabled, without a rect.

selectionType.title: SelectionType
selectionType.description: What kind of text is selected: code inside pre, code, kbd or samp or dense with code syntax; a question ending in a question mark; a single word; over 500 characters; or anything else.

language.description: The selection's language as a primary subtag, e.g. "es": from its writing system or common words, else the nearest lang attribute. Absent when neither says, which native takes as the user's language.

selectionRect.title: SelectionRect
selectionRect.description: The selected text's bounds in CSS pixels, relative to the viewport. Multiply by devicePixelRatio for physical pixels.
